property_summary: For any callee that reverts, the reference contract's forward call itself reverts (propagates failure), whereas the mutant swallows the call result and therefore does not revert; the test asserts that calling forward on a reverting callee always reverts.
change_summary: Remove the require so forward never reverts based on the call result (call failures are still propagated only if call returns false, so behavior differs when call fails but previously required true).
